jessica (sec-eng): Heads up — a customer reported that when they export console audit logs (CSV/JSON) the export file is missing some audit fields and contains truncated user metadata. They also can't download it due to a 403. Anyone seen this?

marta (security): I saw one similar in staging last week. The export path calls the audit service with a service-account role that doesn't have decrypt permissions for the exports KMS key. That yields a permission error and fallback truncation logic.

omri (platform): Can you paste the error payload? I think the export flow tries to decrypt envelope metadata for pii_masking and if it fails we redact fields.

audit-bot: Incident detected: export_failed -> reason: kms:DecryptDenied; count=3; sample_request_id=exp-42ab9

jessica (sec-eng): Sample from support: `403 Forbidden: kms:DecryptDenied` and the file they're able to download has user.email -> "REDACTED_TRUNC" and ip_address missing. They need full audit records for customer compliance.

kevin (devex): UI side also has a permission check: only roles with permission `console.audit.download` show the export button. If the backend KMS role is missing decrypt rights the backend returns 403 but UI still shows a generic error modal. We should improve the UX messaging.

daniel (product): Two concerns: (1) customers expect a complete CSV/JSON for their exported events; (2) internal auditors need to be able to export without switching projects. Proposal: add a distinct role `audit_exporter` with explicit KMS decrypt permission scoped to audit export keys + console permission `console.audit.download`.

marta (security): Agree. Also need to validate schema coverage: some customer-submitted events (sso.login.succeeded) show up in UI but export schema doesn't include `identity.provider` which we actually store encrypted. So even when decrypt works, those fields are missing from the CSV.

omri (platform): Quick fix plan: 1) add IAM role `redwood-audit-exporter@<proj>` with kms:Decrypt on audit key; 2) change export microservice to return 403 with structured JSON explaining KMS missing vs RBAC missing; 3) don't auto-redact on decrypt failure — fail the export and surface guided remediation.

jessica (sec-eng): That would avoid silent truncation. Also we need an automated validation job that compares in-DB audit rows with export schema nightly and flags missing fields.

kevin (devex): For UX: change the error modal to show: "Export failed: service account missing KMS decrypt permission — contact infra@redwood.com or ask your admin to grant role 'audit_exporter'." Add a tooltip on the export button that mentions export may require extra permissions.

marta (security): Here's a minimal repro curl for the export call (use staging):

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST "https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/audit/exports" \
  -d '{"format":"csv","start":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-15T23:59:59Z","filters":{"project_id":"proj-123"}}'
```

If the service-account doesn't have kms:Decrypt you'll get a 403 and an export record state=failed with reason=kms_decrypt_denied in the exports table.

omri (platform): For the exports table, we should add an `error_code` and `error_details` JSON blob (note: this is a schema change). Also add `schema_version` on exported payloads so we can detect mismatches.

jessica (sec-eng): Marta, can your team enumerate which audit event types currently have encrypted fields that need to be included in exports? We can map them to schema_version changes.

marta (security): I'll list them. Quick ones: `sso.login.*` -> identity.provider (encrypted), identity.email (encrypted), `kms.key.create/delete` -> key_id (clear), but we also redact `key_material_preview` which should never export. I will produce a CSV within 24h.

daniel (product): Owners and timeline proposal: Platform (Omri) — add role + change export service (2d); Security (Marta) — audit event field matrix + schema bump (1d); DevEx (Kevin) — UI messaging + tooltip (1d); SecEng (Jessica) — night validation job + alert (3d).

omri (platform): ACK. I'll also gate the export endpoint with an explicit pre-check that verifies KMS access before streaming. If pre-check fails return 403 + code `KMS_DECRYPT_MISSING` with remediation link.

kevin (devex): I'll prototype the modal text and the tooltip content. Also propose we add an inline link to the export permission docs from the modal.

audit-bot: Task created: EXPORT-452 add audit export role & pre-check; assigned to omri; due_date=1893540000

jessica (sec-eng): Thanks team. After we have the schema_version in exports, we'll run a sample validation and let the customer know the expected fields and whether export contains PII that is always redacted.

marta (security): One more note — for on-prem/private deployments we'll need guidance for customer KMS/HSM roles; I'll draft a KB entry.

jessica (sec-eng): Great. Action items recap in thread: Omri add role & pre-check, Marta produce field matrix + KB draft, Kevin UI updates, Daniel review messaging for customers, Jessica implement nightly validation. Reopen thread with any blocking infra perms. :thumbsup:
